summary: Star Mountain Lower Middle-Market Capital Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Sixth Amendment to its Loan and Servicing Agreement with Webster Bank as agent and lenders. The amendment adjusts advance rates on certain loan assets, reduces aggregate commitments from $200 million to $185 million, modifies concentration limits, extends the maturity date from June 30, 2028 to July 3, 2029, and amends a swing loan definition. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No change of control, shareholder action,或 strategic transaction is involved; the registrant remains the borrower under the facility. What to watch: continued compliance with amended covenants and utilization of the reduced facility.
